origin.twinborn.twinborn.description: The two of you arrived in this world together, and you wish to leave it the same way. A Twinborn shares everything with their twin: strength, health, breath, even death.
origin.twinborn.twinborn.name: Twinborn
power.twinborn.never_alone.description: While your twin is offline you can't do anything. You wait in a grey world, unseen and unhurt, until they come back. Whenever your twin dies, you die with them.
power.twinborn.never_alone.name: Never Alone
power.twinborn.red_thread.description: When you both choose it, a red thread 12 blocks long ties you together. It catches your falls, halves your fall damage and lets both of you climb walls while it holds.
power.twinborn.red_thread.name: Red Thread
power.twinborn.shared_blood.description: While you have full breath your twin can't drown, and the same goes for you. The food you eat feeds your twin a little, and the potions you drink, the effects your food gives and the poisons creatures put on you reach your twin as well.
power.twinborn.shared_blood.name: Shared Blood
power.twinborn.sharing.description: Trade max health, armor, attack damage, attack speed, reach, speed and experience levels with your twin, one step at a time. One of you asks and the other gives, and whatever one of you gains, the other loses.
power.twinborn.sharing.name: Sharing
power.twinborn.side_by_side.description: When you both agree, you can call your twin to your side or go to theirs from anywhere, even another dimension. You can also send the items lying around you to your twin's feet.
power.twinborn.side_by_side.name: Side by Side
power.twinborn.twin_bond.description: You need a twin. Look at another Twinborn and choose Bond in your twin bond menu while they do the same for you, and the two of you are bound until one of you takes another origin. Your twin's face stays in the corner of your screen, and you can always find them through walls.
power.twinborn.twin_bond.name: Twin Bond
